explication: Brave Core customizes Chromium into the Brave browser; the README emphasizes this role, while the sampled tree shows browser features across desktop, Android, and iOS. A representative user workflow is choosing a search engine in settings, with distinct private-window preferences. Other visible capabilities include wallet and DApp interactions, news, tab management, iOS content blocking, and passage-embedding model availability. Source excerpts are sparse and several listed subsystems are unsampled, so the graph limits internal wiring to relationships evidenced by the excerpts.
